data.one_liner: A customizable pull-to-reveal and swipe-to-trigger widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Wrap any widget to capture vertical or horizontal pull gestures and trigger custom actions. Supports multi‑stage thresholds, long‑press combo locks, shake‑to‑cancel and a built‑in pull‑to‑refresh constructor.
use_when: You need a generic gesture wrapper beyond the standard RefreshIndicator
You want multi‑stage pull thresholds or secure long‑press‑then‑drag interactions
You require shake‑to‑cancel or real‑time progress callbacks
avoid_when: Only a simple list refresh is required
You prefer a full‑featured UI kit rather than a low‑level primitive
You need heavy state‑management or dependency‑injection solutions
strengths: Highly customizable with multi‑direction and multi‑stage support
Built‑in secure combo lock and shake‑to‑cancel features
No runtime third‑party dependencies besides sensors_plus
Provides a progress stream for advanced effects
weaknesses: Adds a sensor dependency which may need permissions on Android/iOS
May be overkill for simple pull‑to‑refresh use cases
Limited to gesture handling; not a complete UI kit
data.setup_notes: Add the package and, if using shake‑to‑cancel, ensure sensors_plus is configured (Android may require sensor permissions).

alternatives.name: flutter_slidable
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides ready‑made swipe‑to‑action list items without custom gesture handling
